intuition: Place one queen per row while tracking occupied columns and both diagonal directions.

brute_force.approach: Try every arrangement of n queen positions and reject any pair that attacks.

optimal.approach: Backtrack row by row and test column and diagonal sets before placing each queen.

edge_cases: For n = 1, the board containing one queen is the sole solution.
For n = 2 or n = 3, no valid board exists.
